title: POSCO Group signs lithium supply deal with China's CATL through 2028
text:
POSCO Group signs lithium supply deal with China's CATL through 2028 - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 21일(토) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Industry POSCO Group signs lithium supply deal with China's CATL through 2028 
 입력 2026.11.18. 16:44 업데이트   2026.11.18. 16:45 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 POSCO Group will supply lithium, a key raw material for lithium-ion batteries, to China's Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd. (CATL), the world's largest electric vehicle battery maker.
 POSCO Group said on the 18th that it had signed a contract to supply lithium to CATL for three years through 2028. POSCO Group said it is already supplying lithium under the contract.
 A view of POSCO Holdings' Hombre Muerto salt flat in Argentina. /Courtesy of POSCO Holdings CATL accounts for around 40% of the global electric vehicle battery market. Its global market share was found to be 39.1% in January-September this year, according to data compiled by SNE Research.
 POSCO Group expects the contract with CATL to help strengthen its sales base in China.
 POSCO Group said, "The supply contract with CATL is significant in terms of securing high-quality resources in advance, which Chairman Chang In-hwa has emphasized."
